claims.text: The rider was actively coordinating and the driver went silent on him. The rider's message at 16:57:23 — inside the free waiting period, which ran from 16:55:05 — reads 'coming down now'; the driver read it at 16:57:53 and never replied. The chat log holds only 2 messages, trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and the driver terminated the trip at 17:01:56, 243 seconds after reading the rider's message and 273 seconds after it was sent. POL-NS-04(a) is satisfied by that locating/coordinating message and POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied because the driver neither posted a reply within 120 seconds nor made any in-app voice call before terminating. The rationale POL-NS-04 states therefore applies to this record: an unanswered coordinating message converts the failed pickup into a driver-side coordination failure, not a rider who simply never appeared. I do not assert POL-NS-04(c) (see the rider-track claim below), so I put this forward as the driver's coordination failure on this record, not as a complete answer to POL-NS-01.

There is no traffic advisory behind this pickup, and the driver cannot manufacture one. EV-ADVIS-02702-01 is MISSING — the issue detail reads 'No advisory covers Tampines Mall in this window' — with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and I disclose that impairment expressly. I cite the artifact only for its absence, which POL-GEN-02(3) makes citable and which carries no fact for either party. The consequence is that POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable on this record: without a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period, no in-geofence interval may be accumulated and no lawful-hold excuse exists for where the driver put the vehicle at Tampines Mall.

The rider's own track must be contained, not over-read. It records 69 fixes, all stationary (distinct speed 0.0), at 853.9 m to 861.4 m from the pickup pin (min_distance_m 853.883 m; rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). That defeats POL-NS-04(c) and I do not assert otherwise. But under POL-NS-11 the rider_track decides only whether POL-NS-04 can exonerate the rider: it is not evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell, it does not impair the gps_trace for the driver's arrival or dwell under POL-NS-08(b), it cannot be left as the sole evidence for a deciding fact, and it cannot ground escalation under POL-NS-09(e). The driver's arrival and dwell stand or fall on his own track, which is clean and complete.

The arrival marker on this trip is a driver-pressed BUTTON (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON), so POL-NS-12 does not apply and the driver takes no benefit from the platform-confirmed-arrival shortcut. Arrival must therefore be established on the exported trace under POL-NS-02: at least three consecutive position fixes, each carrying a reported horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, inside the 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE zone class. I ask the Judge to require the qualifying-fix count to be built only from fixes whose accuracy is actually reported at 25 m or better, because POL-NS-02 requires the accuracy to be reported and a fix with no reported accuracy cannot satisfy that limb.

The failed pickup cannot be written off as pin ambiguity. trip_record carries registered_pickup_points = 1, not 2 or more, and the pickup carries venue_id VEN-TAMPINES-MALL. POL-NS-03(ii) attributes a mislocation to pin ambiguity, and funds the platform goodwill payment, only where neither party specified a sub-location AND two or more pickup points are registered at the pin; on this record that route is closed. The driver therefore cannot attribute the missed pickup to an ambiguous pin, and no platform-funded goodwill arises on that basis.

The in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 409 seconds, from 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, measured from the first qualifying GPS fix as POL-NS-01(c) requires; that is more than double the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, and no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set).

The trip was terminated by the driver at 17:01:56 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - after the required 180-second dwell had elapsed at 16:58:03 - and the record shows no boarding event, so POL-NS-01(d) is satisfied.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this decides the $4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02702. The fee stands and the driver is paid $3.60.

WHY THE FEE STANDS (POL-NS-01, all four limbs). (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:55:03. (b) The GPS trace places him inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (Tampines Mall) - 42 qualifying in-geofence fixes, which answers POL-NS-02. (c) He then held position in one continuous in-geofence run of 409 seconds, 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set), and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) The trip was terminated at 17:01:56 under RIDER_NO_SHOW - after the 180-second dwell elapsed at 16:58:03 - with no boarding event recorded.

TO THE RIDER. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. It needs all three limbs. Limb (a) is arguable on your 16:57:23 message 'coming down now' and limb (b) is met by the driver's silence, but limb (c) fails affirmatively: your own device is tracked at 853.9-861.4 m from the pickup pin throughout, with zero fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a large venue. With (c) failed the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01, as your own rider-track claim acknowledged. The chat therefore corroborates the driver: more than two minutes into the wait you were still not at the pickup point. POL-NS-03 does not apply either - the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

TO THE DRIVER. Your payout is 80% of the $4.50 fee = $3.60, fixed by POL-NS-07 and matching the money block (4.50 x 0.8). The anti-farming check on your profile does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the 4-or-more limb, so compensation is paid and the fee stands.

CHECKS THAT DID NOT DISPLACE THE FEE. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is genuine - at 16:55:03 the driver's nearest fix is 0.16 m from the pin and stationary - so the waiting clock runs from the marker and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06: there is no shortfall, 409 seconds exceeding the 180-second minimum, so no refund arises and no advisory-accumulation is needed. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so arrival is established on the exported trace itself. POL-NS-11: the rider's track is not evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not impair his trace.

INTEGRITY AND WEIGHT (POL-GEN-02). The only artifact below weight 1.0 is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02702-01 (MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); it is cited only for its absence and carries no deciding fact, so it does not cap confidence. The artifacts that do carry the deciding facts - EV-GPS-02702, EV-TRIP-02702 and EV-FARE-02702 - all sit at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0; my confidence is 0.90. The ledger reconciles to the policy figure under POL-NS-08(d) (charged 4.50 = platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so no integrity ground to refund arises.

NO ESCALATION, NO REFERRAL. No artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; no integrity limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged; no profile-counter condition for review is met; and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically unless appealed under POL-GEN-04.

The rider's point that registered_pickup_points is 1 and that no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises is correct but moot. But limb (c) is affirmatively failed: the rider's own track records 69 fixes, all stationary, at 853.883 m to 861.377 m from the pickup pin (rider_presence.min_distance_m / max_distance_m), with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). POL-NS-04 states that where limb (c) is affirmatively failed the clause does not apply, so the driver's silence does not convert this into a driver-side coordination failure.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m. The rider's point that registered_pickup_points is 1 and that no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises is correct but moot. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival marker the driver was 0.16 m from the pin and stationary, so the marker is not false. POL-NS-06 does not fire: the 409-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall; the accumulation limb (i) is unavailable in any event because EV-ADVIS-02702-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — a fact both sides disclosed and neither relies on for a payment.

The rider's request that arrival be re-tested only on fixes with a reported accuracy of 25 m or better is rejected. The derived qualifying_fix_count of 42 already applies the POL-NS-02 accuracy filter (gps_accuracy_filter_m 25), the record is not recomputed, and POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON.

Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee: SGD 3.60 (fare_breakdown derived driver_compensation 3.60; rate 0.80). The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4-or-more limb — so compensation is paid and the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60.

The rider's track does not impair the driver's evidence for arrival and dwell (POL-NS-11), no POL-NS-08 limb is engaged (arrival fix within 5 s of the event, max_gap_sec 0.0, 87 fixes, chat sequence intact with 2 of 2 messages, fare line reconciles to the 4.50 net figure), and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the two admissible instruments agree, confidence is above the 0.70 floor, and the profiles show no repeat-dispute or abuse pattern (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d 0; disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both sides).

Confidence is 0.90. The deciding facts — the driver's arrival and his 409-second dwell — are carried by EV-GPS-02702 and EV-TRIP-02702, each with weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 POL-GEN-05 execution threshold and executes automatically. No clause produces a referral."

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the S$4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid S$3.60 (80% of the fee in force). On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling, amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd per POL-GEN-03; the rider's charge is left in place and the S$3.60 is what this ruling moves.

Why the fee is chargeable (POL-NS-01). All four conditions hold on the instruments. (a) EV-TRIP-02702 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:55:03. (b) EV-GPS-02702 places the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (Tampines Mall) in 42 consecutive qualifying fixes, his nearest fix being 0.16 m from the pin. (c) His in-geofence dwell is one continuous run of 409 seconds, from 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause requires; that exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02702 platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set, and the older zone minimum_dwell_sec is not applied to a record that carries platform_policy). (d) The record shows no boarding and termination by the driver at 17:01:56 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 233 seconds after the 180-second dwell elapsed at 16:58:03.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the 16:55:03 marker timestamp the driver's nearest fix was 0.16 m from the pin and he was stationary, so the waiting clock is the marker clock and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not bite: with a 409-second dwell against a 180-second minimum there is no shortfall, so no refund follows from that clause.

The rider's arguments. (1) You say you messaged 'coming down now' at 16:57:23 and the driver never replied, so POL-NS-04 should exonerate you. POL-NS-04 requires all three limbs, and limb (c) fails on your own device track in EV-GPS-02702: 69 fixes, all around 854 m from the pickup pin (min 853.88 m, max 861.38 m), none inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE zone. Because limb (c) is affirmatively failed, POL-NS-04 does not apply and the fee is decided under POL-NS-01. Your related point under POL-NS-11 is accepted: the rider track decides only whether POL-NS-04 exonerates you, it does not impair the driver's trace for arrival or dwell, and the driver's arrival and dwell stand on his own clean, complete track. (2) POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so arrival is established from the exported trace under POL-NS-02; I decline your request to impose an extra accuracy requirement, because nothing in the record shows the 42 qualifying fixes lack a reported accuracy. (3) The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02702-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) makes any accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, but that clause needs a shortfall and there is none, so the point does not change the outcome. (4) POL-NS-03(ii) is not reached: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance outside it, so registered_pickup_points = 1 and the pin-ambiguity goodwill route does not arise.

Driver compensation (POL-NS-07). POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the driver is paid 80% of the S$4.50 fee in force = S$3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4-or-more limb. The fare ledger EV-FARE-02702 charges exactly S$4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, reconciling under POL-NS-08(d), so no integrity defect arises. No artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired, so the confidence cap is 1.00 and confidence is set at 0.90; the S$3.60 monetary effect is below the S$8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

Both parties: this was a verified rider no-show, and the driver is owed his share of the fee. The driver's 'arrived' marker ('I'm Here') is at 16:55:03 (trip record EV-TRIP-02702), and the exported GPS trace (EV-GPS-02702) shows a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 409 seconds, from 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, at a nearest fix 0.16 m from the pickup pin and stationary. The pickup zone class is LARGE_VENUE, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, and 42 consecutive qualifying fixes fall inside it. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is not set), so the required dwell elapsed at 16:58:03; the driver terminated the trip at 17:01:56 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the record shows no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02702) charges exactly the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee stated in platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so it reconciles under POL-NS-08(d) and there is no integrity defect to refund. Under POL-NS-07 the driver's payout is 80 percent of the 4.50 SGD fee, i.e. 3.60 SGD, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 2/113 completed trips is 0.018 (below 0.08). The ruling is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and POL-GEN-03 makes amount_sgd the same 3.60 SGD figure as the driver compensation; the rider's charge stands. On the rider's arguments: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate, because although the rider's coordinating message 'coming down now' was sent at 16:57:23 and the driver never replied within 120 seconds, limb (c) is affirmatively failed - the rider track (EV-GPS-02702) sits between 853.9 m and 861.4 m from the pickup pin throughout, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius - so the clause does not apply and the failed pickup is decided under POL-NS-01. POL-NS-06 gives no relief: the measured dwell of 409 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall, and the traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02702-01) is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0 - it is cited only for its absence, carries no fact, and is not relied on. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius (not outside it but within 400 m), and with registered_pickup_points = 1 the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) does not arise. POL-NS-05 confirms the marker is not false: at 16:55:03 the driver was at the pin and stationary, not over 300 m away or moving at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-12 gives no shortcut because the arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON rather than GPS_AUTO, but the exported trace independently establishes arrival and dwell in any event. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): there is no clock skew over 90 seconds, no sampling gap over 120 seconds and full 100 percent coverage, the chat sequence is intact and matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare line equals the fee in force. No POL-NS-09 escalation ground (a) to (e) is present. The deciding facts rest on artifacts of weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0; no context-only profile field was used as a ground of decision, and the driver's references are to the citable POL-NS-07 pair. The monetary effect, 3.60 SGD, is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The rider was actively coordinating and the driver went silent on him. The rider's message at 16:57:23 — inside the free waiting period, which ran from 16:55:05 — reads 'coming down now'; the driver read it at 16:57:53 and never replied. The chat log holds only 2 messages, trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and the driver terminated the trip at 17:01:56, 243 seconds after reading the rider's message and 273 seconds after it was sent. POL-NS-04(a) is satisfied by that locating/coordinating message and POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied because the driver neither posted a reply within 120 seconds nor made any in-app voice call before terminating. The rationale POL-NS-04 states therefore applies to this record: an unanswered coordinating message converts the failed pickup into a driver-side coordination failure, not a rider who simply never appeared. I do not assert POL-NS-04(c) (see the rider-track claim below), so I put this forward as the driver's coordination failure on this record, not as a complete answer to POL-NS-01.

There is no traffic advisory behind this pickup, and the driver cannot manufacture one. EV-ADVIS-02702-01 is MISSING — the issue detail reads 'No advisory covers Tampines Mall in this window' — with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and I disclose that impairment expressly. I cite the artifact only for its absence, which POL-GEN-02(3) makes citable and which carries no fact for either party. The consequence is that POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable on this record: without a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period, no in-geofence interval may be accumulated and no lawful-hold excuse exists for where the driver put the vehicle at Tampines Mall.

The rider's own track must be contained, not over-read. It records 69 fixes, all stationary (distinct speed 0.0), at 853.9 m to 861.4 m from the pickup pin (min_distance_m 853.883 m; rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). That defeats POL-NS-04(c) and I do not assert otherwise. But under POL-NS-11 the rider_track decides only whether POL-NS-04 can exonerate the rider: it is not evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell, it does not impair the gps_trace for the driver's arrival or dwell under POL-NS-08(b), it cannot be left as the sole evidence for a deciding fact, and it cannot ground escalation under POL-NS-09(e). The driver's arrival and dwell stand or fall on his own track, which is clean and complete.

The arrival marker on this trip is a driver-pressed BUTTON (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON), so POL-NS-12 does not apply and the driver takes no benefit from the platform-confirmed-arrival shortcut. Arrival must therefore be established on the exported trace under POL-NS-02: at least three consecutive position fixes, each carrying a reported horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, inside the 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE zone class. I ask the Judge to require the qualifying-fix count to be built only from fixes whose accuracy is actually reported at 25 m or better, because POL-NS-02 requires the accuracy to be reported and a fix with no reported accuracy cannot satisfy that limb.

The failed pickup cannot be written off as pin ambiguity. trip_record carries registered_pickup_points = 1, not 2 or more, and the pickup carries venue_id VEN-TAMPINES-MALL. POL-NS-03(ii) attributes a mislocation to pin ambiguity, and funds the platform goodwill payment, only where neither party specified a sub-location AND two or more pickup points are registered at the pin; on this record that route is closed. The driver therefore cannot attribute the missed pickup to an ambiguous pin, and no platform-funded goodwill arises on that basis.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-06T16:55:03+08:00 ('Driver tapped I'm Here'), so POL-NS-01(a) is satisfied; the record shows the free-waiting timer starting two seconds later at 16:55:05.

The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is met on the driver's own trace: 42 consecutive position fixes qualify inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup zone at Tampines Mall, so the geofence requirement of POL-NS-01(b) holds.

The in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 409 seconds, from 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, measured from the first qualifying GPS fix as POL-NS-01(c) requires; that is more than double the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, and no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set).

The trip was terminated by the driver at 17:01:56 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - after the required 180-second dwell had elapsed at 16:58:03 - and the record shows no boarding event, so POL-NS-01(d) is satisfied.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05: at the 16:55:03 marker timestamp the driver's in-geofence run begins, his nearest recorded fix is 0.16 m from the pickup pin, and the trace shows stationary (0.0 kph) fixes, so the waiting clock is the marker clock and the corrected dwell is the full 409 seconds.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. On the rider's own track the device sits between 853.9 m and 861.4 m from the pickup pin throughout, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE zone, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed and the clause does not apply on these facts.

POL-NS-06 does not displace the fee: the measured dwell of 409 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall and the driver has no need of the advisory-accumulation limb (i) - a point on which the MISSING traffic advisory (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is expressly not relied on.

The chat log corroborates the driver's account rather than the rider's: the driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 16:55:28, and the rider's only reply, 'coming down now' at 16:57:23, shows the rider was still not at the pickup point more than two minutes into the wait.

The fare breakdown charges exactly the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee stated in platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the ledger reconciles under POL-NS-08(d), the fare line is not defective, and there is no integrity ground to refund the fee.

Under POL-NS-07 the driver's payout is 80 percent of the 4.50 SGD fee in force, i.e. 3.60 SGD, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, short of the 4-or-more limb, so compensation is paid and the fee stands.
